changelog:
x-tweet-by-conversation 1.0.0

- Initial release: extract all tweets from an X (Twitter) conversation thread given a conversation id (root tweet id).
- Returns normalized data for each tweet: text, author details, engagement counts, media, hashtags, mentions, reply mappings, and pagination cursor.
- Step-by-step support for session checks, login verification, URL construction, and paginated scraping via network activity.
- Handles full reply and sub-reply collection, including "Show more replies" gating and error cases (deleted/protected tweets, captchas).
- Suitable for thread scraping, sentiment analysis, controversy mapping, AMA/Q&A harvesting, and reply tree export.
summary: Collects every tweet in an X (Twitter) conversation thread given a conversation id (root tweet id) — the focal tweet plus all replies, sub-replies, and quote chains — and returns normalized per-tweet data with text, author, engagement counts, media, hashtags, mentions, in_reply_to mapping, and curso
